findings.title: Legacy embeddable hosts are inserted without normalization and will not match the new host check
findings.body: The old `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts` values could include full URLs and paths, as shown by the removed specs using `http://discourse.org` and `https://example.com/1234`. This migration inserts each `h` verbatim into `embeddable_hosts.host`, but `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?`/`record_for_host` parses the incoming referer and compares only `uri.host` to the stored `lower(host)`. A migrated value like `http://example.com` will never match `example.com`, so existing full-URL host configurations silently stop allowing embeds after upgrade.

findings.title: before_validation crashes when host is nil
findings.body: `before_validation` calls `self.host.sub!` before any presence or format validations run. If a request creates or updates an `EmbeddableHost` with a missing/null `host`, this raises `NoMethodError` on nil and returns a 500 instead of a normal validation error. The callback should guard with `self.host.to_s` or a presence validation should be added before mutation.

findings.title: Missing records and malformed params cause 500 errors
findings.body: `update` and `destroy` use `EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first`, which can be nil for an unknown ID. `update` then passes nil to `save_host` and calls `host.host=`, while `destroy` calls `host.destroy`, both raising `NoMethodError`. Additionally, `save_host` unconditionally dereferences `params[:embeddable_host]`, so malformed input without that root key also raises. These should return 404/JSON errors instead of 500s.

findings.title: Hosts saved with a port can never match
findings.body: The host format validation allows an optional `:port` (line 2), and `before_validation` does not strip it. However `record_for_host` compares only `uri.host` to the stored `lower(host)`, ignoring `uri.port`. A host entered as `example.com:8080` will therefore never match `http://example.com:8080`. Either reject ports in the validation or include the port in the lookup comparison.

findings.title: Category and embeddable host fabricator contents were swapped
findings.body: `spec/fabricators/category_fabricator.rb` now defines `Fabricator(:embeddable_host)`, while `spec/fabricators/embeddable_host_fabricator.rb` contains the `:category`, `:diff_category`, `:happy_category`, and `:private_category` definitions. This looks like an accidental file-swap. It may work in the full suite if all fabricator files are loaded, but the file named `category_fabricator` no longer defines `:category` and direct requires or future maintenance will be broken. The contents should be moved back.

findings.title: GET /fruits/:id always returns the first fruit, so the id-2 test exercises the wrong record
findings.body: The test changed to `store.find('fruit', 2)` and asserts `fruitCols.length` is 2 with color ids 1 and 2, but this pretender route always sets `const fruit = fruits[0]` regardless of the requested id. The assertion therefore still validates fruit id 1, not fruit id 2's actual single-color array, and would not catch errors in the plural `_ids` hydration for a single element.

findings.title: No action-level tests for embeddable host admin CRUD
findings.body: The new admin controller specs only assert that the controllers inherit from `Admin::AdminController`. They do not exercise `create`, `update`, or `destroy`, staff authorization, invalid host input, missing categories, or missing-record behavior. Since this PR introduces a new admin CRUD API and changes embedding access control, these cases should be covered.
